versus_selected.method: paired sequence-cluster percentile bootstrap with pooled global recomputation
versus_selected.assumption: sequences are sufficiently independent; model-selection bias is not corrected

selection.rationale: initialize and teacher-anchor at best predeclared existing configuration under development Global WP; new pooled-loss learning rate is conservative and unvalidated

objective.prediction_clip_derivative: one strictly inside (-2,2); zero at endpoints and outside
objective.rho_bound_derivative: zero strictly outside [-1,1] for numerical roundoff safeguard
objective.weight: absolute clipped target; one denominator per target over time and batch
objective.degenerate_policy: rho0 and zero correlation gradient when pooled weight<floor or either pooled std<=floor; target retained with correlation loss1
objective.aggregation: pool time and batch rows per target; equal mean over two global target losses
objective.domain: all TRAIN post-warmup rows; no validation mask or per-sequence sign eligibility
objective.surrogate_scope: batch-pooled correlation is a surrogate for complete-corpus Global WP; batches do not yield additive correlation losses
objective.teacher: raw selected-ORT predictions; unclipped weighted MSE with the same pooled label weights and one denominator per target
objective.accumulation: FP64; current ORT FP32 values preserved; FP64 inputs accepted for derivative audits
objective.coefficient: detached FP32 d(total mean loss)/d(raw prediction), includes teacher weight and two-target mean only
objective.chunk_rule: compute once over the complete sequence batch; sum(proxy_prediction*coefficient_slice), no extra mean or scaling
objective.gradient_scale: correlation contains inverse pooled prediction standard deviation; legacy per-sequence learning rates require reassessment
objective.state_scope: future labels used only in training loss; no feature/state/callback mutation

reserved_policy: excluded from new adaptation; inventory is not proof of no prior exposure; pretrained lineage unknown
evaluation_policy: training_only; score each completed arm once on existing screen, both once on full development; no postprocess or epoch search; confirmation permanently excluded
